snippet.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 | Adventure Time Pack Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce our first pack making its way to PowerWash Simulator 2 - Adventure Time!

Things have gone ba-nay-nay across the Candy Kingdom, and it's up to you to clean up the schmutz.

Wishlist here:
https://bit.ly/PWS2_AdventureTimeSteam
https://bit.ly/PWS2_AdventureTimeEpic
https://bit.ly/PWS2_AdventureTimeXbox

This Adventure Time Pack will be splashing into PowerWash Simulator 2 Spring 2026 on Steam, Epic Games, Windows Store, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2

PowerWash Simulator 2 is available now! https://www.bit.ly/PWS2Steam

For more pressure washing goodness, subscribe to our channel! ⤵️
Follow our Twitter for daily satisfying content: https://bit.ly/TwitterPWS
Join the conversation on our Discord: https://discord.gg/powerwashsimulator
Follow us on TikTok for quick-spray socials: https://bit.ly/PWSTikTok
